REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 12, 2017 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT HELD ON JANUARY 12,
2017, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD
AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Mark Lohman, New Life Community Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by the Mambas Rookie III Basketball team.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Carol Chen
  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor/Chair George Ray

  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki was noted as absent from the meeting.

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  None.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Christopher Craig, field representative for Assemblymember Cristina Garcia,
  introduced himself and announced the Assemblymember's upcoming events.

  Roger Kline spoke in support of allowing the citizens to vote on a proposed sales
  tax measure.

  Lynda Johnson introduced herself as the field Deputy for Los Angeles County
  Supervisor Janice Hahn.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes and
  Cerritos Financing Authority Special Meeting Minutes of December 8, 2016
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY/FINANCING AUTHORITY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes and Cerritos Financing
  Authority Special Meeting Minutes of December 8, 2016 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY/FINANCING AUTHORITY). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:
 City of Cerritos  January 12, 2017

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7A.  (continued)

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated January 12,
  2017 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated January 12, 2017 in the
  amount of $20,200,438.16 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos
  Redevelopment Agency dated January 12, 2017 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment
  Agency dated January 12, 2017 in the amount of $397,746.70 (SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

7D.  Approval of the Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending November 30, 2016
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending November 30, 2016
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

7E.  Review and consideration of final approval of Parcel Map 73910, a request by
  SBMC Mesmer, L.P., to subdivide one (1) existing parcel into two (2) separate
  parcels for leasing and/or selling purposes. The subject property is located at
  13910, 13915, and 13950 Cerritos Corporate Drive, Cerritos, California, 90703
  and is zoned industrial (M) (APN 7003-001-033) (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15315 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA),
  this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  This item was pulled from the Consent Calendar for separate consideration by
  Councilmember Chen.
 City of Cerritos  January 12, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 8

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7E.  (continued)

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Pulido, to accept, file and
  authorize recordation of Parcel Map No. 73910, subject to the final approval of the
  City Engineer (COUNCIL). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt Ordinance No.
  1010, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONTRACT BETWEEN THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND THE BOARD OF ADMINISTRATION
  OF THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT SYSTEM (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to waive full
  reading of and adopt Ordinance No. 1010, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO
  THE CONTRACT BETWEEN THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  AND THE BOARD OF ADMINISTRATION OF THE CALIFORNIA PUBIC
  EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM (COUNCIL). The motion carried (4 – 0) as
  follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of 2017 City Council/Successor Agency meeting
  date changes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.
 City of Cerritos  January 12, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 8

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to:

  1. Cancel the Thursday, March 23, 2017 City Council/Successor Agency meeting
  and hold a special meeting on Monday, March 20, 2017; and
  2. Cancel the Thursday, April 20, 2017 City Council/Successor Agency budget
  study session and hold the study session at the Thursday, April 27, 2017
  Regular City Council/Successor Agency Meeting (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of Cerritos Library policies for public computer use
  and internet access and wireless network access (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian and Marketing
  Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Tracy Winkler inquired whether this item was a revenue generating proposal.

  Anantha Ramachandran spoke in opposition to charge for Wi-Fi service.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Chen, to:

  1. Approve the Cerritos Library Public Computer Use and Internet Access Policy
  (which does not include a guest computer use fee) and Wireless Network
  Policy; and
  2. Direct the City Manager and/or his designee to purchase and implement a
  public computer reservation system; and
  3. Direct the City Manager and/or his designee to implement a one-year pilot
  test of a guest Wi-Fi service with fees of $5 or more per day, $25 per month
  and $50 per year (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  January 12, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 8

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9D.  Review and consideration of Cerritos Library budget reductions for Fiscal Year
  2017-2018 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian and Marketing
  Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Sally Havice expressed concerns regarding proposed cut to Library services and
  hours.

  Anantha Ramachandran expressed opposition to any reduction in Library
  services or hours of operation.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Edwards, to continue this
  item to the April 27, 2017 budget study session (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (3 – 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  Chen
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

9E.  Review and consideration of approval for expenditure of funds for the
  replacement of a booster motor at the C-4 Booster Station located at 16807
  Studebaker Road in the City of Cerritos (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Public Works Director.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1. Make a finding that staff has determined that the purchase of a new
  motor is necessary; and
  2. Approve the expenditure of funds in the amount of $21,302.79 to pay for
  the purchase and installation of a new 200 HP Motor of C-4 Booster
  Station in the City of Cerritos to General Pump Company; and
  3. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute changes in the
  scope of work and related expenses if necessary (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  January 12, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 6 of 8

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9F.  Review and consideration of approval for expenditure of funds for the
  removal and replacement of six valves located at the Los Cerritos Center Mall
  in the City of Cerritos (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Public Works Director.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1. Make a finding that staff has negotiated a fair and reasonable cost for the
  installation of the six 12-inch valves located in the Los Cerritos Center
  Mall area; and
  2. Approve the expenditure of funds in the amount of $16,988.30 to pay for
  the purchase of six valves and related hardware by the Water Division
  3. Approve the expenditure of funds in the amount of $46,353.00 to pay for
  the installation of six valves located in the Los Cerritos Center Mall area to
  W.A. Rasic Construction; and
  4. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute changes in the
  scope of work and related expenses if necessary (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

9G.  Review and consideration to execute amendments to the City’s agreements
  with Athens Services and Calmet Services’ request for street sweeping rate
  adjustment (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Mike O’Grady, Environmental Services Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to authorize the
  City Manager to execute amendments to the City’s agreements with Athens
  Services and Cal Met services formalizing the agreed changes in the City’s
  street sweeping operation (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  January 12, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 7 of 8

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9H.  Review and consideration of solid waste management consulting services for
  the City of Cerritos (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Mike O’Grady, Environmental Services Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to:

  1. Authorize staff to retain the services of HF&H Consultants, if necessary, to
  assist in renegotiating an extended agreement with CalMet Services, Inc.;
  and
  2. Begin the process of negotiating with CalMet Services, Inc. for an
  agreement to commence July 1, 2017; and
  3. Return to the City Council with a status report of the negotiations on or
  prior to the April 13, 2017 City Council meeting (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State
  or Federal Legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for
  signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on
  Meetings

  Pursuant to unanimous City Council agreement, the Mayor opened public
  comments.

  San H. Yoo expressed concern with a tree issue on his property.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments.

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Edwards, Pulido, and Chen, and
  Mayor Ray.

12.  Closed Session

  None.
 City of Cerritos  January 12, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 8 of 8

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 8:49 p.m.
